mapper.select: SELECT guardian_contact_id, phone_number FROM guardian_contacts WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guardian_contacts (user_id, phone_number) VALUES (#{userId}, #{phoneNumber}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE phone_number = #{phoneNumber}
mapper.select: SELECT anomaly_event_id, recipient_name, amount, risk_level, final_action, guardian_notified_at FROM anomaly_events WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND anomaly_event_id = #{anomalyEventId} AND risk_level = 'HIGH'
